business_problem: People's Daily needed a unified intelligent-media platform that could speed up planning, creation, review and distribution across modern newsroom workflows while handling large video and data volumes.
solution_summary: People's Daily and Baidu built 'Creation Brain' as an end-to-end intelligent media-production platform rather than a single feature. Under the hood, Baidu AI Cloud supplies the media cloud foundation for storage, compute, network access and AI chips, while media knowledge, intelligent creation and intelligent video platforms expose language, vision and knowledge-graph capabilities into editorial workflows. Those capabilities are mapped across the full newsroom chain: intelligent planning aggregates creative resources and recommends topics, intelligent collection and editing support article, video and short-form news generation, intelligent review performs multi-dimensional checking of text and media assets, and AI anchors expand reporting timeliness and coverage. The system therefore acts as a newsroom operating platform where large volumes of text, video, graphics and monitoring data are ingested, enriched and then distributed in multiple formats. Rather than only cutting labor, the architecture gives People's Daily a shared media-AI infrastructure layer for news production, analytics and content-governance tasks.

data_flow: Text, video, image and monitoring data flow into the Creation Brain platform, where planning and creation services generate newsroom assets, review services check them, and video and distribution modules publish the outputs across media channels.
business_outcome: People's Daily gained an integrated AI newsroom foundation that accelerates multimedia production, review and distribution while making intelligent media tools usable in day-to-day editorial work.
metrics: Traditional manual review of every 100,000 characters takes 3.3 days, while machine review can finish in seconds.
architecture_clues: The platform spans planning, collection, editing, review and distribution
Media cloud infrastructure is paired with specialized media knowledge, creation and video platforms
